title: Who owns each gate?
prompt: Assign each readiness task to its owner.

pairs.item: Create the datasource and enable it for a test group.
pairs.why: Admins configure datasources and their visibility.

pairs.item: Grant a token with global scope, if one is truly needed.
pairs.why: Only Super Admins can grant global scope.

pairs.item: Issue read-only source credentials and a current sandbox.
pairs.why: The source owner controls keys and environments.

pairs.item: Approve where secrets are stored and which egress is open.
pairs.why: Hosting and network choices are security decisions.

pairs.item: Run the first-run check and record the results.
pairs.why: The builder proves one public and one permissioned document behave correctly.

takeaway: A gate without an owner is a gate nobody closes.
